svg.desc: Factories in Mahalla El Kobra LOCATION Mahalla El Kobra, Egypt CLIENT Cotton & Textile Industries Holding Co. COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2025 2 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Landscape Design Project Overview This completed project in Mahalla El Kobra involves constructing new textile, dyeing, and preparation factories for Misr Spinning & Weaving Co., along with external networks and service buildings. Services include design review, supervision, quality and HSE compliance, material approval, and cost control, all within the project schedule. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings and site supervision.
